mechanism_narrative: An increase in the federal funds rate by more than 0.5% within a month signals a tightening monetary policy, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as borrowing costs rise and economic activity slows.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces positive 20-day returns in more than 50% of instances following a >0.5% FEDFUNDS increase.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp rise in unemployment rate (UNRATE) by more than 0.5% within a month indicates weakening labor market conditions, which historically precedes negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances following a >0.5% UNRATE increase.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in real GDP (GDPC1) over two consecutive quarters signals a weakening economy, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days as corporate earnings expectations are revised downwards.
failure_condition: S&P 500 forward returns are positive in more than 50% of instances following a two-quarter GDPC1 decline.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in industrial production (INDPRO) by more than 2% within a month signals a strengthening supply side, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days as market sentiment improves.
failure_condition: S&P 500 forward returns are negative in more than 40% of instances following a >2% INDPRO increase.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) by more than 0.25% within a month signals a loosening monetary policy, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as liquidity increases and risk appetite improves.
failure_condition: S&P 500 forward returns are negative in more than 40% of instances following a >0.25% FEDFUNDS decrease.

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts (HOUST) decline by more than 10% and consumer price index (CPIAUCSL) increases by more than 2% within a month, it signals a demand shock, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as inflationary pressures and reduced housing activity weigh on economic growth.
candidate_trigger: HOUST declines > 10% and CPIAUCSL increases > 2% in 1 month
failure_condition: S&P 500 forward returns are positive in more than 50% of instances following the specified HOUST and CPIAUCSL conditions.

mechanism_narrative: An always-on signal where a high level of nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) relative to its 12-month moving average indicates strong labor market conditions, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days as consumer spending and corporate earnings are supported.
failure_condition: S&P 500 forward returns are negative in more than 40% of instances when PAYEMS is above its 12-month moving average.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in real GDP (GDPC1) and decrease in retail and food services sales (RSAFS) by more than 1% within a quarter signals a shift in consumer spending patterns, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as market participants reassess economic growth prospects.
candidate_trigger: GDPC1 increases and RSAFS decreases > 1% in 1 quarter
failure_condition: S&P 500 forward returns are positive in more than 50% of instances following the specified GDPC1 and RSAFS conditions.
